# JOIST LLC

> JOIST is a Yakima, Washington firm that handles compliance with Washington's Clean Buildings Performance Standard (CBPS) for building owners anywhere in the state. For Tier 2 buildings (20,000 to 50,000 sq ft, plus multifamily over 20,000 sq ft), JOIST's fee is matched to the state's $0.30/sq ft Early Adopter Incentive, so most owners pay nothing out of pocket.

## Key facts
- Services: ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager benchmarking, Energy Management Plans, operations and maintenance programs, state submittal, Early Adopter Incentive applications, exemption filings.
- Tier 2 filing deadline: July 1, 2027 (WA Department of Commerce).
- Tier 1 (over 50,000 sq ft): pricing typically half to a third of larger firms.
- Team: Jacob James, CEM (owner, auditing commercial and industrial facilities since 2014); Candice Kelly, CEM (Clean Buildings Engineering Lead); Caleb Smith (Construction Project Manager).
- Licensed, bonded and insured: WA contractor license JOISTL*750K2.
- Office: 6 South 2nd St. Suite 413, Yakima, WA 98901. Phone: (509) 379-8956. Email: jacob@joistgc.com.
